payload.entry:
cycler-fixes complete. All five audit findings were real and are fixed in task-status-cycler 1.34.0 (block-id-prompt src unchanged, tests only).

1. Cross-note Depends-On ids are resolved against the vault (Tasks cache when Warm, else markdown scan via readSuccessorNoteText) before planning. Only an id that resolves to an open task is a remaining project or own-reason; a missing id never blocks (DC7). recoverProjectResidentsAfterPrjUnblock resolves first, then plans.
2. Cycling ^prj out of [?] to any non-Blocked status recovers tagged open residents, including Alt+[ to Cancelled when the note is no longer project(T).
3. A transcluded ^prj recovers residents in its source note through vault.process (no editor).
4. block-id-prompt: resident consumption is its own test; notice-order asserts /^Project blocked by dependency · / (not the Task blocked · project reason fallback).
5. README cycler row restored the tagged-residents sentence, dropped nav prune-live-links text, fixed the stray double space, and describes 1–3. Manifest 1.33.0 → 1.34.0.

Regression tests in test-task-status-cycler-blocked-schedule.cjs fail on the pre-fix fragments (reverted 088/160/180, rebuilt, 5 failures) and pass with the fix. Vectors: DC7 missing-id, PDB resident recovery, UB WRITE [unblocked::] via ledger-tools v12.

npm test: 2554 pass, 6 fail — the allowed bob-cli-6v (4 unblocked-glyph), bob-cli-6w (Keep counts once), bob-cli-3w (stage-ranker timing). npm run validate ok. Deployed task-status-cycler on this host (bob plugins sync -n -r opened bob-plugins -p task-status-cycler). No memory notes edited. No epic-symbols on this phase.

Verified: cross-note Depends-On ids resolve before resident recovery (closed target recovers, open target keeps tags, resident own closed prereq recovers); Alt+[ to Cancelled and transcluded ^prj recover residents; five new tests fail on pre-fix cycler fragments; block-id-prompt resident case split and notice-order exact; cycler README/manifest 1.34.0; npm test 2554 pass with only allowed 6v/6w/3w failures; validate ok; deployed task-status-cycler on this host.

payload.entry: nav-fixes done. 1) Move promotion (215): ^prj walk-through now runs before the ? gate, so a [?] ^prj never promotes itself but its open Depends-On targets still rise; closed lines still return 0. New test 'walks through a [?] ^prj to its open prerequisite' failed on old build (no R.md change) and passes now. 2) Reversal (665+new 666 fragment, registered in fragments.json): post-write rewrites that throw or find changed content count planned links as failed; any failure keeps the project note with 'Restored the task in <parent>, but N links could not be updated; <note> was kept' plus the Pomodoro suffix when the daily rewrite failed. New tests (linking-note-changed, daily-rewrite-failure) fail 2/24 on old code, pass now. 665 stays under 1000 lines (979). 3) Schedule-tag: new update/delete tests with resident recovery missing (own open Depends-On, ^prj closed history) strip the tag while resident stays [?]; exactly those 2 fail on a7fafed code. 4) Wiring: plugin-level test through applyCountedLocalTaskDependency and Task Link batch test through deleteLinkPickerPropertyValue, both asserting [unblocked::] via fake freshness API; each fails when its markUnblockedLine wiring is removed (2 fail, 41 pass with both removed). 5) Dropped dead projectPrjKeepsDependsOnReason/projectResidentRecoveryClears defs+exports; added countPlannedRewriteLinksByPath/applyPlannedBlockIdLinkRewrites exports. Manifest 2.26.0->2.27.0, README nav row bumped + keep-notice phrase, bob-cli docs/task-dependencies.md §13.10 keep-sentence. Verify: npm run build ok, npm test 2556/2561 (only allowed bob-cli-6v x4 + bob-cli-6w x1), npm run validate 6/6, bob plugins sync -p bob-navigation-hotkeys deployed on this host (2 copied), bob-cli just check fails only the allowed bob-cli-6m percent-listen x2. Tree left uncommitted in both repos for the land agent to stitch; epic-symbols clean.
